description: Compose a transaction to create a fair minting launch for a new asset. For XCP-420 compliant launches, use compose_xcp420_fairminter instead.

burn_payment.description: Whether payment is burned (true) or sent to issuer (false)

divisible.description: Whether the asset is divisible (8 decimal places)

hard_cap.description: Raw integer max total supply. For divisible: human amount * 10^8.

inputs_set.description: Comma-separated UTXOs to use as inputs (txid:vout)

lock_quantity.description: Lock supply so no further issuance is possible

max_mint_per_address.description: Raw integer max per address. For divisible: human amount * 10^8.

max_mint_per_tx.description: Raw integer max per tx. For divisible: human amount * 10^8.

mime_type.description: MIME type for inscription (e.g. image/png, text/plain)

premint_quantity.description: Raw integer amount to premint to issuer. For divisible: human amount * 10^8.

price.description: Raw integer price per mint in the payment asset (XCP). For XCP: human amount * 10^8 (e.g. 0.1 XCP = 10000000).

quantity_by_price.description: Raw integer tokens received per price payment. For divisible: human amount * 10^8.

sat_per_vbyte.description: Fee rate in satoshis per virtual byte (e.g. 1, 5.5, 0.15). Check get_fee_estimate for current market rates.

soft_cap.description: Raw integer soft cap. For divisible: human amount * 10^8.

soft_cap_deadline_block.description: Deadline block for reaching soft cap. Must be less than end_block.

name: compose_fairminter
